items.title: Balchi di Pisca
steps: These delectable fish balls can also be made with salmon or fish fillets. Substitute one large can of salmon or one pound of any white fish for the cod.
Soak for twenty-four hours:
1 salted cod, or bakijow Discard the water.
Place cod in saucepan with fresh water to cover.
Simmer gently until the fish flakes easily when tested with the tines of a fork.
Strain, reserving a bit of the broth.
De bone the cod and set it aside for later use.
In a saucepan, bring to boil in water to cover: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and diced When the potatoes are tender, drain them well.
Add the cod and mash the two ingredients thoroughly together.
Place in the container of an electric blender:
1 tomato, peeled and chopped
1/2 green pepper, chopped
1 medium onion, peeled and chopped
1 clove garlic, slivered
1/2 tsp. Tabasco sauce, or minced hot pepper
Dash of nutmeg
Salt and pepper to taste
Blend for a few seconds and pour the sauce over the mashed fish mixture.

Combine these ingredients well and add 1 egg, beaten Mixture should be stiff enough to mold into balls about one and a half inches in diameter, If it's too dry, add the fish stock a tablespoon at a time.
Fry the balls in hot, deep fat until golden brown.

items.title: Tirolean Dumplings
steps: Finely chop the shallots, and dice the smoked ham or sausage into small cubes.
Heat some butter or clarified butter in a pan and sweat the onions in it until translucent.
Add the meat and the parsley and fry together briefly before removing from the heat.
Place the bread in a bowl.
Beat the milk with the eggs and season well with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Pour over the bread.
Stir in the sausage and onion paste and mix in the flour.
Mix together to form a relatively firm paste (adding more bread or flour if necessary) and season again according to taste.
Smooth the surface of the dough out and leave to stand for approx.
30 minutes.
Heat up a good quantity of salted water in a large pan.
Use the paste to form smaller dumplings (for use as a garnish in soups) or medium-sized dumplings, as required.
Moisten the hands regularly with cold water during this stage so that the dumplings take on smooth forms.
Place in boiling water, bring back to the boil, turn down the heat, and simmer gently for 8-20 minutes, depending on the size.
Remove from the water, dry off well and serve up garnished with chopped parsley and melted butter (which has been taken on a nut-brown colour).

items.title: Jamaican Boiled Dumplings
steps: Instructions
In a large pot, bring water and salt to a boil to boil the dumplings.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the all-purpose flour and salt, stirring to distribute the salt evenly throughout the flour.
Gradually add water to the flour mixture, mixing with your hands until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into equal-sized pieces, rolling each into a smooth ball. Flatten each ball slightly with the palm of your hand to form a round, circular dumpling. It should look like a thick disk.
Carefully drop the dumplings into the boiling water, one at a time, ensuring that they don't stick together. You can use a wooden spoon to stir the dumplings in the water.
Boil the dumplings for 15-20 minutes, or until they are cooked through and have risen to the surface of the water. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Use a slotted spoon to remove the cooked dumplings from the pot, allowing any excess water to drain.
Serve with your favorite recipes.

items.title: Classic Christmas pudding
steps: Get everything for the pudding prepared.
Chop the almonds coarsely.
Peel, core and chop the cooking apples.
Sharpen your knife and chop the candied peel.
(You can chop the almonds and apples in a food processor, but the peel must be done by hand.) Grate three quarters of the nutmeg (sounds a lot but it's correct).
Mix the almonds, apples, candied peel, nutmeg, raisins, flour, breadcrumbs, light muscovado sugar, eggs and 2 tbsp brandy or cognac in a large bowl.
Holding the butter in its wrapper, grate a quarter of it into the bowl, then stir everything together.
Repeat until all the butter is grated, then stir for 3-4 mins – the mixture is ready when it subsides slightly after each stir.
Ask the family to stir too, and get everyone to make a wish.
Generously butter two 1.2 litre bowls and put a circle of baking parchment in the bottom of each.
Pack in the pudding mixture.
Cover with a double layer of baking parchment, pleating it to allow for expansion, then tie with string (keep the paper in place with a rubber band while tying).
Trim off any excess paper.

Now stand each bowl on a large sheet of foil and bring the edges up over the top, then put another sheet of foil over the top and bring it down underneath to make a double package (this makes the puddings watertight).
Tie with more string, and make a handle for easy lifting in and out of the pan.
Watch our video to see how to tie up a pudding correctly.
Boil or oven steam the puddings for 8 hrs, topping up with water as necessary.
Remove from the pans and leave to cool overnight.
When cold, discard the messy wrappings and re-wrap in new baking parchment, foil and string.
Store in a cool, dry place until Christmas.
To make the brandy butter, cream the butter with the orange zest and icing sugar.
Gradually beat in the brandy or cognac and chopped stem ginger.
Put in a small bowl, fork the top attractively and put in the fridge to set.
The butter will keep for a week in the fridge, or it can be frozen for up to six weeks.
On Christmas Day, boil or oven steam for 1 hr. Unwrap and turn out. To flame, warm 3-4 tbsp brandy in a small pan, pour it over the pudding and set light to it.

items.title: Holiday Wine-Braised Short Ribs
items.creator: Joan Nathan
ingredients: 6 pounds bone-in short ribs (at least 1 ½ inches thick), cut into 2- to 4-inch pieces
Coarse kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
2 carrots, cut on the diagonal into 2-inch pieces
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro or parsley, for serving
Sichuan chile oil (optional), homemade or store-bought, for serving
steps: Heat oven to 250 degrees.
Place short ribs on a plate and season with salt and pepper.
Warm olive oil in a 7-quart Dutch oven (or other large, heavy ovenproof pot with a lid) over medium heat.
Using tongs, sear meat for about 3 minutes per side to give it some color.
Return the pieces to the plate, reserving the oil and fat in the pot.
Add onion to the Dutch oven and stir occasionally until softened, 5 to 7 minutes.
Stir in cumin, curry powder, cinnamon, brown sugar and ketchup.
Add meat along with red wine, ginger ale, soy sauce, tomato, jalapeño (if using), rosemary, bay leaves, carrots, and lastly the celery.
Cover and transfer to the oven.
Cook for about 4 hours, until the meat is fork-tender and falls off the bones.
Remove and discard the celery, rosemary, bay leaves and jalapeño (if used).
Let cool in the Dutch oven, then chill in the refrigerator at least overnight and up to 2 days.
When ready to serve, heat the oven to 350 degrees.
Remove and discard the solidified fat on top of the meat and reheat the short ribs, covered, in the oven until warmed through, about 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Transfer to a serving platter, sprinkle with cilantro or parsley and serve with a small bowl of Sichuan chile oil if you’d like.

items.title: Furikake
items.creator: Mia Leimkuhler
ingredients: 3 sheets unseasoned nori (dried seaweed sheets for sushi)
⅔ cup roasted sesame seeds (see Tip)
Optional mix-ins (add to taste): shichimi togarashi, gochugaru, crushed potato or corn chips, dried onion flakes, fried garlic (see Tip)
steps: Crumble the nori sheets into a food processor.
(If your nori sheets aren’t crisp enough to easily crumble, carefully toast them first by waving them over a gas flame or placing them under a broiler for a few seconds.)
Add the sesame seeds, salt, sugar and bonito flakes, if using, and pulse until the mixture is well blended and the nori pieces are about the size of grains of rice.
Stir in any additional mix-ins.
Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place or the fridge for up to one month.

items.title: Pommes Purée (French Mashed Potatoes)
items.creator: Alexia Duchêne
ingredients: 2 lb. 4 oz. large Yukon gold potatoes (5–7)
1 cup (2 sticks) chilled unsalted butter, sliced
A food mill and a fine-mesh tamis
steps: Place 2 lb.
4 oz. large Yukon gold potatoes (5–7) in a large pot and pour in water to cover by about 2".
Season generously with kosher salt and bring to a boil.
Cook until potatoes are fork-tender, 20–25 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat 1 cup whole milk in a small saucepan over low heat and keep warm.
Drain potatoes.
Working quickly so they remain hot, peel potatoes with a paring knife and cut into pieces.
Pass potatoes through food mill into a medium bowl, then pass through tamis onto a sheet of parchment paper, pressing with a heatproof rubber spatula.
Transfer potato purée to a small pot or large saucepan and cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until dried out a little and steaming, about 3 minutes.
Gradually pour in warm milk, stirring constantly until smooth and spoonable (you might not need all of the milk).
Remove from heat and add 1 cup (2 sticks) chilled unsalted butter, sliced, a few pieces at a time, whisking after each addition until melted and combined before adding more.
Taste pommes purée and season with salt as needed.

items.title: Pommes Dauphine
items.creator: Alexia Duchêne
ingredients: Coarse salt (kosher or sea; for baking potatoes)
1 tsp. Diamond Crystal or ½ tsp. Morton kosher salt, plus more
Peanut oil (for frying and spoons; about 8 cups)
A food mill and a deep-fry thermometer
steps: Place a rack in middle of oven; preheat to 350°.
Sprinkle coarse salt over a rimmed baking sheet to cover (aim for a ¼"–½" thick layer).
Nestle 1 lb. large Yukon Gold potatoes (2–3) into the salt and roast in oven until a knife pierces through flesh with little resistance, about 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and, working quickly so potatoes remain hot, peel with a paring knife and halve.
Pass potatoes through food mill into a medium bowl; set aside.
Bring 4 Tbsp. unsalted butter, 1 tsp.
Diamond Crystal or ½ tsp.
Morton kosher salt, and ⅔ cup water to a simmer in a medium saucepan over high heat, stirring with a stiff heatproof spatula or sturdy rubber spatula to help melt butter and dissolve salt.
Immediately reduce heat to medium; add ⅔ cup all-purpose flour all at once and stir quickly until most of the flour is absorbed.
Cook, stirring vigorously and breaking up pockets of flour as needed, until a thin film forms on bottom and sides of pan and dough comes together into a single mass, 2–3 minutes.
(It should look glossy and feel buttery and smooth.) Remove from heat and let sit in pan until no longer hot but still warm, about 3 minutes.
Add 2 large eggs to mixture one at a time, mixing until incorporated after each addition.
Pâte à choux should be thick, glossy, and fall off spatula in a V-shape.
If it’s too thick, stir in another 1 large egg.
Add dough to reserved potatoes and stir to combine; season with kosher salt.
Pour peanut oil into a medium Dutch oven or large heavy saucepan fitted with thermometer to come 3" up sides (about 8 cups).
Heat over medium-high until thermometer registers 360°.
Reduce heat to medium (you want to maintain the temperature).
Using a spoon lightly coated in oil and working in batches of 6–8, spoon irregular amounts of batter into pot.
Fry, turning often, until golden brown all over, about 4 minutes.
Using a spider or slotted spoon, transfer to a rimmed baking sheet lined with paper towels to drain and immediately season with kosher salt.
Repeat process with remaining batter, adjusting heat as needed to maintain temperature.
Transfer pommes dauphine to a platter to serve.

items.title: Pommes Anna
items.creator: Alexia Duchêne
ingredients: 5 lb. large Yukon Gold potatoes (10–15), peeled
½ cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, sliced
steps: Place a rack in middle of oven; preheat to 400°.
Slice 5 lb. large Yukon gold potatoes (10–15), peeled, lengthwise on a mandoline set to 1-mm thickness.
Brush a large high-sided skillet with some of 1¼ cups clarified butter to coat.
Cut a round of parchment paper to fit bottom of pan and place in pan.
Brush parchment with more clarified butter.
Using cutter and working with a few slices stacked together at a time, punch out enough rounds to fill bottom of pan.
Arrange slices around sides of pan, overlapping slightly, to create a circle (make sure slices are compact and tight).
Repeat process, creating concentric circles, until you have an even layer covering entire bottom of pan.
Drizzle with some clarified butter and generously season with kosher salt.
Repeat process (no need to cut potatoes into rounds), creating more layers, until all of the potatoes slices and clarified butter have been used.
Dot ½ cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, sliced, over final layer of potatoes.
Cover pan with a lid or foil and bake potatoes until tender, 50–55 minutes.
Uncover and bake until deep golden brown in spots, 45–55 minutes more.
Let cool slightly, then place a plate upside down over pan.
Holding plate and pan together, carefully turn over in one swift motion to invert pommes Anna onto plate.
Remove pan.

items.title: Kichererbsen-Möhren-Suppe
items.creator: Olivia
steps: Schäle die Möhren, Zwiebeln und Knoblauch.
Schneide die Möhren in kleine Würfel und hacke die Zwiebeln, den Knoblauch und die Petersilie fein.
Presse den Saft der Zitrone aus.
Gieße die Kichererbsen in ein Sieb und spüle sie mit Wasser ab.
Hebe etwa 4-6 EL Kichererbsen für später zum Garnieren auf.
Erhitze 6 EL Öl in einem großen Topf und dünste alles darin an.
Würze mit Salz, Chiliflocken und Kreuzkümmel.
Lösche mit Gemüsebrühe ab und lass das Ganze zugedeckt für 10-15 Minuten köcheln, bis die Möhren weich sind.
Püriere die Suppe mit dem Pürierstab fein.
Schmecke mit Salz, Pfeffer, etwas Zucker sowie Zitronensaft ab.
Gib die Kichererbsen-Möhren-Suppe in Schüsseln, bestreue sie mit einigen Kichererbsen sowie frischer Petersilie und träufele jeweils 1 EL Olivenöl darüber.
Serviere die Suppe mit warmem Fladenbrot.

items.title: Pflaumen-Galette
items.creator: Kitchen Stories
steps: Vermische für den Teig Mehl mit den gemahlenen Mandeln, Salz, braunem Zucker und Vanillezucker.
Füge die Butterstücke sowie das kalte Wasser hinzu.
Knete die Zutaten mit den Händen zu einem Teig, wickle ihn in Klarsichtfolie ein und lege ihn für 15 Minuten in den Kühlschrank.
Wasche, halbiere und entsteine in der Zwischenzeit die Pflaumen.
Schneide die Hälften noch einmal in der Mitte durch und teile die Viertel in Spalten.
Gib die Pflaumenspalten mit Zucker, Speisestärke, Vanillemark, Salz und Zimt in eine Pfanne und lass alles für 10 Minuten bei mittlerer Hitze köcheln.
Fette eine Tarte- oder Springform mit etwas Butter ein.
Heize den Backofen auf 190 °C Ober- und Unterhitze vor.
Hole den Teig aus dem Kühlschrank, rolle ihn kreisförmig aus und lege ihn in die Form.
Verteile die Pflaumenmischung nun gleichmäßig auf dem Teig.
Lass zum Rand hin rundherum aber ca.
3 cm frei.
Klappe den Rand um, sodass der Teig die äußeren Pflaumen leicht überlappt.
Verquirle das Ei und bepinsle damit den Teigrand der Galette.
Streue anschließend Zucker darüber und backe die Galette für 30 Minuten.
Lass sie vor dem Servieren noch abkühlen.

items.title: Curry-Zucchini vom Grill
items.creator: Kitchen Stories
ingredients: Salz und frisch gemahlener schwarzer Pfeffer
steps: Wasche die Zucchini gründlich und trockne sie mit einem Küchentuch ab.
Entferne den Strunk und schneide die Zucchini in etwa 1,5 cm dicke Scheiben.
Verrühre das Olivenöl mit Currypulver, dem kleingehackten Knoblauch und dem Zitronensaft zu einer gleichmäßigen Marinade.
Bestreiche die Zucchinischeiben von beiden Seiten großzügig mit der Marinade.
Lass die marinierten Zucchinischeiben etwa 15 Minuten ziehen.
Lege die Zucchinischeiben auf eine Grillplatte oder direkt auf den Rost und grille sie pro Seite etwa 5–6 Minuten, bis sie goldbraune Grillstreifen erhalten und weich sind.
Nimm die Zucchini vom Grill und würze sie erst jetzt mit Salz und frisch gemahlenem Pfeffer.
Bestreue die Curry-Zucchini vom Grill mit der gehackten Petersilie.

items.title: Bougatsa
items.creator: Ann-Katrin
steps: Verrühre die Maisstärke mit 1/3 der Milch.
Erhitze die restliche Milch in einem Topf auf mittlerer Stufe.
Verquirle Eier und Zucker in einer Schüssel schaumig.
Gieße die heiße, nicht kochende Milch in die Schüssel mit der Eier-Zucker-Mischung und verrühre alles.
Gieße die Mischung wieder zurück in den Topf und füge die angerührte Maisstärke hinzu.
Rühre, bis die Masse dicker wird.
Lass nach und nach das Grieß und Salz einrieseln und rühre ständig etwa 5 Minuten lang, bis die Masse dick wird.
Gib 150 g der Butter dazu und nimm den Topf vom Herd.
Füge Vanilleextrakt und Zitronensaft hinzu.
Rühre um und lass den Pudding abkühlen.
Heize den Ofen auf 180 °C Ober-/Unterhitze vor.
Fette eine Auflaufform mit Butter ein.
Bepinsle alle Filoteig-Blätter mit dem Rest der Butter.
Lege die Hälfte der Blätter in die Form und verteile den Pudding gleichmäßig darüber.
Lege die restlichen Blätter darüber.
Backe die Bougatsa etwa 30 Minuten im Ofen.
Bestreue sie anschließend mit Puderzucker.

items.title: Salsiccia mit Mangold und Senfzwiebeln: Rezept
items.creator: Gelinggarantie
steps: Zwiebeln vierteln und in feine Streifen schneiden.
Senfsaat in einer Pfanne rösten, bis sie zu springen beginnt.
Feigen in feine Scheiben schneiden.
Zucker in einem Topf mit schwerem Boden hellbraun karamellisieren.
Lorbeer, Zwiebeln und Senf zugeben und unter Rühren kurz dünsten.
Mit Portwein und Essig auffüllen und offen bei milder Hitze ca.
20 Minuten garen, bis die Flüssigkeit fast vollständig verkocht ist.
Feigen zugeben und 5-10 Minuten unter rühren garen.
Mit Salz und Pfeffer würzen.
Mangold putzen, Blätter von den Stielen und den Mittelrippen schneiden.
Stiele und Rippen waschen und quer in feine Streifen schneiden.
Mangoldblätter klein schneiden.
Zwiebeln in feine Streifen schneiden.
Für die Salsicce je 2 Lorbeerblätter mit etwas Küchengarn um 1 Wurst binden.
Öl in einer Pfanne erhitzen, Bratwürste darin bei starker Hitze 8 Minuten braten, dabei mehrmals wenden.
Für das Mangoldgemüse Olivenöl und Butter in einem Topf erhitzen.
Zwiebeln und Mangoldstiele darin 4 Minuten dünsten, mit Salz würzen.
Mangoldblätter und Mineralwasser zugeben und bei mittlerer Hitze 2-4 Minuten mitgaren.
Zitronenschale unterrühren.
Mit Pfeffer würzen.
Salsicce mit dem Mangold in einer Pfanne anrichten. senfzwiebeln dazu servieren.
Dazu passt Ciabatta.

items.title: Air Fryer Fried Chicken
items.creator: Skinnytaste
ingredients: 2 ½ cups bran flakes (4 ½ ounces* (or gluten-free crushed corn flakes))
1 tablespoon kosher salt (less if you are using regular salt, divided)
steps: Season chicken with 1 teaspoon kosher salt.
Crush the cereal in a food processor or chopper until fine.
In a mixing bowl combine the crushed cereal with the remaining salt, paprika, garlic powder and dried parsley, if using.
Place in a shallow dish or ziplock bag.
Using a cooking brush, brush mayo onto the chicken then coat the chicken with crushed cereal mixture.
Place in the air fryer basket and spray the tops of the chicken with oil.
Air fry 370°F 22 to 24 minutes, turning the chicken halfway and spraying the top again, until the crumbs are golden and the chicken is cooked through.

items.title: Porridge mit Schokolade, Nüssen und Beeren
items.creator: Malte's Kitchen
steps: Die Haferflocken mit dem Kakao in einen kleinen Topf geben und 150 ml der Milch angießen, salzen.
Nun bei kleiner Hitze langsam erhitzen und zwischendurch verrühren.
Während die Haferflocken quellen, das Obst waschen und klein schneiden.
Den Apfel fein reiben.
Schluckweise mehr Milch zum Porridge geben, bis es eine schöne, geschmeidige Konsistenz hat, einmal kurz aufkochen.
Den geriebenen Apfel unterheben.
Zum Schlüssel leicht süßen, wenn du magst.
Das Porridge auf einen Teller geben und mit Nüssen und Früchten belegen, zum Schluss das Nussmus darüber sprenkeln.

items.title: Mediterranean Cucumber Salad
items.creator: RecipeTin Eats
ingredients: 500g / 1 lb Lebanese cucumbers (, ~3 medium, sliced in 3-4mm / 1/8" thick (US: Persian cucumbers, mini cucumbers in the UK) - Note 1)
1/4 cup roughly chopped fresh dill ((Note 2 if you don't have))
1/4 cup roughly chopped fresh mint ((Note 2 if you don't have))
1 tbsp fresh lemon juice ((substitute white or red wine vinegar, or apple cider vinegar))
1 small garlic clove (, crushed using garlic press or finely grated using microplane)
1/4 heaped tsp cooking salt / kosher salt
steps: Dressing - Shake the ingredients in a jar until well combined (or whisk in a bowl).
Set aside to let the flavours meld while you chop.
Toss - Put the cucumbers, herbs, onion and most of the feta in a bowl (reserve a bit for topping).
Add dressing and toss.
Serve - Pour into a serving bowl.
Top with remaining feta and serve straight away, though it keeps well for an hour, and I still enjoy it the next day (it becomes semi-pickled).

items.title: Is Salmon Good With Berries? Sweet Spicy Berry Salmon Nuggets for Meal P
items.creator: FitMenCook
ingredients: 1 tsp sriracha | Juice of ½ lemon | Salt to taste |
steps: Season and sear salmon cubes until golden on all sides.
Sauté onion until soft, add berries, citrus, coconut sugar, sriracha, and vinegar.
Simmer until thickened into a glossy sauce.
Serve over basmati rice with lime wedges.

items.title: Apricot & Turkish delight mess
steps:
step 1
Place the mascarpone, yogurt, sugar and orange flower water into a large bowl and whisk until thickened.
Fold the remaining ingredients through, then divide the mix between 2 dessert glasses or bowls and decorate with extra mint, if you like.

items.title: Empanadas Fritas de Queso
steps: Sift the flour, baking powder, and salt into a large mixing bowl.
Combine the lard and milk in a saucepan, and heat until the milk is hot.
Pour the hot milk into the flour mixture, and stir until a dough forms.
Turn out onto a floured surface, and knead until smooth and elastic.
Cover, and allow to rest for 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Roll the dough out on a floured surface 1/4-inch thick.
Cut into 4-inch rounds.
Brush the outer edges of each circle with beaten egg, and fill with a small mound of cheese.
Fold each circle in half to form a half-moon; press the edges with your fingers or a fork to seal.
Place the empanadas onto a parchment paper-lined baking sheet.
Brush the tops with remaining egg.
Bake in preheated oven until golden-brown, about 20 minutes.
Alternatively, the empanadas may be deep fried in 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) oil. If deep frying, do not brush the outsides of the empanadas with egg. Drain on paper towels.

items.title: Lamb Biryani
ingredients: ½ tsp dissolved in ½ cup warm milk Saffron
steps: Grind the cashew, poppy seeds and cumin seeds into a smooth paste, using as little water as possible. Set aside.
Deep fry the sliced onions when it is hot.
Don’t overcrowd the oil.
When the onions turn light brown, remove from oil and drain on paper towel.
The fried onion will crisp up as it drains.
Also fry the cashewnuts till golden brown.
Set aside.
Wash the rice and soak in water for twenty minutes.
Meanwhile, take a big wide pan, add oil in medium heat, add the sliced onions, add the blended paste, to it add the green chillies, ginger garlic paste and garlic and fry for a minute.
Then add the tomatoes and sauté them well till they are cooked and not mushy.
Then to it add the red chilli powder, biryani powder, mint, coriander leaves and sauté them well.
Add the yogurt and mix well. I always move the skillet away from the heat when adding yogurt which prevents it from curdling.
Now after returning the skillet back to the stove, add the washed lamb and salt and ½ cup water and mix well.
Cook for 1 hour and cook it covered in medium low heat or put it in a pressure cooker for 6 whistles.
If the water is not drained totally, heat it by keeping it open.
Take another big pan, add thrice the cup of rice you use, and boil it.
When it is boiling high, add the rice, salt and jeera and mix well.
After 7 minutes exact or when the rice is 80% done.
Switch off and drain the rice.
Now, the layering starts. To the lamb, pat and level it. Add the drained hot rice on the top of it. Garnish with fried onions, ghee, mint, coriander leaves and saffron dissolved in milk.
Cover the dish and bake in a 350f oven for 15 minutes or till the cooked but not mushy.
Or cook in the stove medium heat for 12 minutes and lowest heat for 5 minutes.
And switch off.
Mix and serve hot!

items.title: French Onion Chicken with Roasted Carrots & Mashed Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry all produce. Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into ¼-inch-thick pieces. Dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion.
Toss carrots on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast until browned and tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, place potatoes in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, 12-15 minutes. Drain and return potatoes to pot; cover to keep warm.
While potatoes cook, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and softened, 8-10 minutes.
Sprinkle with 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings).
Stir in stock concentrate and 2 TBSP water (¼ cup for 4); season with salt and pepper.
Cook until jammy, 2-3 minutes more.
Turn off heat; transfer to a small bowl.
Wash out pan.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper.
Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for onion over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes per side.
In the last 1-2 minutes of cooking, top with caramelized onion and cheese.
Cover pan until cheese melts.
(If your pan doesn’t have a lid, cover with a baking sheet!)
Heat pot with drained potatoes over low heat; mash with sour cream, 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings), salt, pepper, and a splash of water (or milk, for extra richness) until smooth.
Divide chicken, roasted carrots, and mashed potatoes between plates.

items.title: Dominica’s coconut rough cake
steps: Mix all dry ingredients in bowl
Add coconut milk to dry ingredients
Grease baking pan with vegetable oil
I use an ice cream scoop to form drops. I placed the scooped cake mixture on a baking sheet. I also used a cake mold and gently pressed the mixture in. You can use a baking pan as well.
Preheat your over at 350°
Bake for 25 to 35 minutes or until brown

items.title: Easy Strawberry Pie
items.creator: Lindsay Ostrom
ingredients: 12 full sheets graham crackers, crushed (1 1/2 cups of crumbs)
1/2 cup sugar (use 3/4 cup if your berries are less sweet)
3 ounces dry strawberry Jell-O powder (half a box, or 5-6 tablespoons)
steps: Graham Cracker Crust: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Mix crust ingredients and press into a 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 350 for 10 minutes.
Wash the strawberries well and blot them dry with a paper towel.
Cut off the tops.
If they are large, cut them all in half.
If they are small, you can leave them as-is or just cut some of them in half.
In a small saucepan, whisk the sugar, cornstarch, and cold water.
Cook over medium-low heat, stirring continuously, until it begins to thicken.
Once it starts bubbling, cook it for another two minutes.
Add Jell-O and stir till dissolved.
Remove from heat and let it cool slightly.
Arrange half of the berries in your prepared pie crust.
Pour some of the cornstarch mixture over the berries and jiggle it around a bit to make sure the mixture goes in and around all the berries.
Repeat with the remaining berries on top, and cover with just enough of the cornstarch mixture to coat the berries and hold them in (you’ll have a bit of cornstarch mixture left over).
Press the berries in so they are real cozy with each other, and brush the top with the cornstarch mixture to make the top glossy.
Refrigerate for 4-6 hours. (I refrigerate uncovered until it’s mostly set, then cover with plastic.
This is best served within 24 hours, because the strawberries will start to soften and release juices.)
Using a hand mixer, beat the heavy cream until soft peaks form.
In a separate bowl, beat the softened cream cheese until smooth.
Slowly beat in the maple syrup with the cream cheese until it is loose and creamy.
Fold the cream cheese mixture into the whipped cream.
Serve the pie slices cold, with a dollop of the whipped cream cheese on top!

items.title: Peanut Butter Cheesecake
steps: Oil and line a 20cm round loose- bottomed cake tin with cling film, making it as smooth as possible.
Melt the butter in a pan.
Crush the biscuits by bashing them in a bag with a rolling pin, then stir them into the butter until very well coated.
Press the mixture firmly into the base of the tin and chill.
Soak the gelatine in water while you make the filling.
Tip the ricotta into a bowl, then beat in the peanut butter and syrup.
Ricotta has a slightly grainy texture so blitz until smooth with a stick blender for a smoother texture if you prefer.
Take the soaked gelatine from the water and squeeze dry.
Put it into a pan with the milk and heat very gently until the gelatine dissolves.
Beat into the peanut mixture, then tip onto the biscuit base.
Chill until set.
To freeze, leave in the tin and as soon as it is solid, cover the surface with cling film, then wrap the tin with cling film and foil.
To defrost, thaw in the fridge overnight.
To serve, carefully remove from the tin. Whisk the cream with the sugar until it holds its shape, then spread on top of the cheesecake and scatter with the peanut brittle.

items.title: Recheado Masala Fish
steps: Soak all the spices, ginger, garlic, tamarind pulp and kashmiri chilies except oil in vinegar.
Add sugar and salt.
Also add turmeric powder.
Combine all nicely and marinate for 35-40 mins.
Grind the mixture until soft and smooth. Add more vinegar if required but ensure the paste has to be thick so add vinegar accordingly. If the masala paste is thin then it would not stick to the fish.
Rinse the fish slit from the center and give some incision from the top. You could see the fish below for clarity.
Now stuff the paste into the center and into the incision. Coat the entire fish with this paste. Marinate the fish for 30 mins.
Place oil in a shallow pan, once oil is quite hot shallow fry the stuffed mackerels.
Fry until golden brown from both sides
Serve the recheado mackerels hot with salad, lime wedges, rice and curry.

items.title: Breakfast Potatoes
steps: Before you do anything, freeze your bacon slices that way when you're ready to prep, it'll be so much easier to chop!
Wash the potatoes and cut medium dice into square pieces. To prevent any browning, place the already cut potatoes in a bowl filled with water.
In the meantime, heat 1-2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Tilt the skillet so the oil spreads evenly.
Once the oil is hot, drain the potatoes and add to the skillet. Season with salt, pepper, and Old Bay as needed.
Cook for 10 minutes, stirring the potatoes often, until brown. If needed, add a tablespoon more of oil.
Chop up the bacon and add to the potatoes. The bacon will start to render and the fat will begin to further cook the potatoes. Toss it up a bit! The bacon will take 5-6 minutes to crisp.
Once the bacon is cooked, reduce the heat to medium-low, add the minced garlic and toss. Season once more. Add dried or fresh parsley. Control heat as needed.
Let the garlic cook until fragrant, about one minute.
Just before serving, drizzle over the maple syrup and toss. Let that cook another minute, giving the potatoes a caramelized effect.
Serve in a warm bowl with a sunny side up egg!

items.title: Asado
steps: Prepare the Fire: Start a wood fire in your grill and let it burn down to coals.
Season the Meat: Generously salt the beef cuts.
Grill the Meat: Place the beef on the grill, starting with the thickest cuts farthest from the coals. Add chorizo and morcilla after the beef has been cooking for a while.
Cook to Perfection: Cook the meat, turning occasionally, until it reaches your desired doneness. Typically, ribs may take up to 2 hours; thinner cuts will cook faster.
Rest and Serve: Let the meat rest for about 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with chimichurri sauce and grilled vegetables.
Pro Tips:
Use a mix of wood and charcoal for a consistent heat source. Wood adds flavor, while charcoal maintains temperature.
Season the meat just before grilling to ensure it retains its moisture and flavor.
Serving Suggestions:
Serve with a side of chimichurri sauce, a fresh tomato salad, and crusty bread. Pair with a robust Malbec wine to complement the rich flavors of the meat.

items.title: Phaphatha Flatbreads
steps: In a stand mixer bowl, combine the dry ingredients: flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
With the dough hook on low, drizzle in the milk.
Continue to knead until a small ball of dough is formed.
Remove the dough from the bowl, oil the bowl lightly, and return the ball of dough to the bowl. Cover and set aside to rest for 15-30 minutes.
Divide the ball of dough into 12 portions, in roughly even lumps.
Heat a small amount of oil in a large, flat skillet.
Flatten a ball of dough with your palm and work it into a slightly larger round with the back of your hand, leaving it a thick round about 10cm (4") in diameter.
Place in the hot skillet.
Repeat with as many rounds as will fit in your skillet.
After 3-4 minutes, once the bottom is slightly browned in spots, flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes on the second side.
